frontend.summary: WebConsole build passed; event log panel supports recent-event loading, WebSocket subscription, UI cap, level filter, and category filter.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: GET /api/events/recent?limit=200&category=doip returns latest N events and supports category filtering
acceptance_criteria.evidence: EventStreamApiTests.RecentEventsApiReturnsLatestLimitedEvents and RecentEventsApiFiltersByCategory; WebApiApplication maps /api/events/recent with bounded limit and category parsing.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: WS /api/events/stream pushes events to clients after publish
acceptance_criteria.evidence: EventStreamApiTests.WebSocketClientReceivesPublishedRuntimeEvent; WebApiApplication subscribes to RuntimeEventHub and sends RuntimeEvent JSON over WebSocket.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Client disconnect and reconnect does not cause service failure
acceptance_criteria.evidence: EventStreamApiTests.WebSocketDisconnectDoesNotPreventReconnect; stream cleanup catches cancellation/WebSocket exceptions and disposes subscription.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: UI keeps at most configured event cap such as 1000 events
acceptance_criteria.evidence: EventLogPanel.vue uses maxEvents = 1000 and slices merged events to the newest maxEvents; RuntimeEventHub default capacity is also 1000.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Frontend log view supports level and category filtering
acceptance_criteria.evidence: EventLogPanel.vue exposes levelFilter/categoryFilter selects and visibleEvents filters by event.level and event.category.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Startup event is visible after page open
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Host publishes runtime.started into the shared RuntimeEventHub after app start; EventLogPanel loads /api/events/recent on mount and after socket open.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Saving configuration shows config event in the log view in real time
acceptance_criteria.evidence: ConfigStore publishes config.saved through the runtime event publisher used by WebApi; EventLogPanel appends WebSocket messages from /api/events/stream.

scope_check.item: No historical log search, file-log indexing, full-text search, or paginated search
No auth, tenant, or external observability integration

lint.reason: Optional non-blocking check for this task; core validation, build, tests, npm build, acceptance criteria, and scope check passed.
